shellCommands.command: git status && git log --oneline | head && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200
cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; grep -rn "export.*configure\|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ----; grep -rln "setLang\|configure" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/ | head -50; echo; grep -n "\"version\"" node_modules/typescript/package.json node_modules/vite/package.json

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -n "ControlGroupOption\b" -A8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "export declare const Text\|export declare const Card\|export declare const Button\|export declare const Header" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components --include=*.d.ts | head

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright; python3 -c "import playwright; print('py playwright ok')" 2>&1 | tail -1
mkdir -p /tmp/e2e-check && cd /tmp/e2e-check && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i playwright@1 2>&1 | tail -2 && timeout 280 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5
whoami; (sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo SUDO_OK) | tail -1; which apt-get

ldconfig -p | grep -i -E "libglib|libnss3|libgbm" | head; ls /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/; ls /tmp/e2e-check/node_modules | grep -i -E "^jsdom|happy" ; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -i -E "^jsdom|happy-dom"
pkill -f "vite preview" ; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm i --no-save jsdom@25 2>&1 | tail -2 && git status --short

rm -f src/i18n/tmp-smoke.test.tsx && rm -rf dist && npm uninstall --no-save jsdom >/dev/null 2>&1; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4 && rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat && cat src/i18n/messages.ts | head -3 >/dev/null
